sites.coord_note: Lunar Module (descent stage) position from LRO images (Wagner et al. 2017); planetocentric Mean Earth/Polar Axis, DE421; Surveyor 3 lies ~180 m away. Four decimals (~30 m digit resolution).

sites.coord_note: Lunar Module (descent stage) position from LRO images (Wagner et al. 2017); planetocentric Mean Earth/Polar Axis, DE421. Five decimals.

sites.coord_note: Centre of the Saturn V third-stage impact crater as measured by LROC; mean Earth/polar axis; LROC table gives 332.1125 E, converted to east-positive (-27.8875, same as NSSDC W column). Stated uncertainty 9.8 m.

sites.name: Apollo 14 S-IVB impact
sites.coord_note: LROC-measured S-IVB impact crater centre; mean Earth/polar axis; 333.9695 E converted to -26.0305. Stated uncertainty 4.5 m.

sites.name: Apollo 15 S-IVB impact
sites.coord_note: LROC-measured S-IVB impact crater centre; mean Earth/polar axis; 348.1755 E converted to -11.8245. Stated uncertainty 3.8 m.

sites.name: Surveyor 1 — Flamsteed P
sites.coord_note: Lander position measured in LROC images; mean Earth/polar axis; LROC gives 316.6602 E, converted to east-positive. Stated uncertainty 5.6 m; older NSSDC Surveyor page gives 2.45 S, 316.79 E.

sites.name: Surveyor 3 — Ocean of Storms
sites.coord_note: Lander position from LROC images (visited by Apollo 12); mean Earth/polar axis; 336.5820 E converted to east-positive. Stated uncertainty 2.6 m; older NSSDC Surveyor page gives 3.01 S, 336.66 E.

sites.name: Surveyor 5 — Mare Tranquillitatis
sites.coord_note: Lander position from LROC images; mean Earth/polar axis. Stated uncertainty 11.9 m; older NSSDC Surveyor page gives 1.41 N, 23.18 E.

sites.name: Surveyor 6 — Sinus Medii
sites.coord_note: Final lander position from LROC images (Surveyor 6 made a short 'hop' after landing); mean Earth/polar axis; 358.5725 E converted to east-positive. Stated uncertainty 6.7 m; older NSSDC page gives 0.49 N, 358.60 E.

sites.name: Surveyor 7 — Tycho north rim
sites.coord_note: Lander position from LROC images; mean Earth/polar axis; 348.4873 E converted to east-positive. Stated uncertainty 3.5 m; older NSSDC Surveyor page gives 40.86 S, 348.53 E (~4 km different).

sites.name: Ranger 6 impact — Mare Tranquillitatis
sites.coord_note: Impact crater centre measured by LROC; mean Earth/polar axis. Stated uncertainty 4.4 m.

sites.name: Ranger 7 impact — Mare Cognitum
sites.coord_note: Impact crater centre measured by LROC; mean Earth/polar axis; 339.3230 E converted to east-positive. Stated uncertainty 6.4 m.

sites.name: Ranger 8 impact — Mare Tranquillitatis
sites.coord_note: Impact crater centre measured by LROC; mean Earth/polar axis. Stated uncertainty 4.9 m.

sites.name: Ranger 9 impact — Alphonsus
sites.coord_note: Impact crater centre measured by LROC; mean Earth/polar axis; 357.6116 E converted to east-positive. Stated uncertainty 5.8 m.

sites.name: Lunar Prospector impact — south polar crater
sites.coord_note: Planned/estimated controlled-impact point (source: Ulivi and Harland 2004, per NSSDC footnote); not imaged; DE421 ME frame stated for the table. One decimal (~0.1 deg, km-scale).

sites.name: LCROSS / Centaur impact — Cabeus
sites.coord_note: Centaur upper-stage impact point in permanently shadowed Cabeus crater (not easily observable per NSSDC footnote); the LCROSS shepherding spacecraft hit nearby at 84.719 S, 49.61 W. DE421 ME frame stated for the table; four decimals.

sites.name: GRAIL-A (Ebb) impact
sites.coord_note: LROC-measured impact crater centre; mean Earth/polar axis; 333.4060 E converted to east-positive. Stated uncertainty 10.7 m.

sites.name: GRAIL-B (Flow) impact
sites.coord_note: LROC-measured impact crater centre; mean Earth/polar axis; 333.1659 E converted to east-positive. Stated uncertainty 12.2 m.

sites.name: LADEE impact — far side
sites.coord_note: LROC-measured impact crater centre; mean Earth/polar axis; 266.7506 E converted to east-positive. Stated uncertainty 6.1 m.

sites.name: Luna 2 impact — first object on the Moon
sites.coord_note: Approximate impact area only (Palus Putredinis, near Autolycus/Archimedes); NSSDC footnote says the site is uncertain, roughly 29-31 N, 1 W-1 E, Siddiqi (2018) says ~30 N / 0 on the slope of Autolycus, and the older NSSDC Soviet-missions page prints 29.10 N, 0.00. Not imaged; precision ~1 deg. Impact time 21:02:23 UT per Siddiqi (2018), who dates it 14 Sep 1959; the date here (13 Sep, UTC) follows the NSSDC 2025 table and NASA History (2019); the 2005 NSSDC page instead gives 14 Sep ~07:30 UT.

sites.name: Ranger 4 impact — far side
sites.coord_note: Predicted/tracked impact point of the uncontrolled spacecraft (first US craft to reach the Moon), not imaged; Siddiqi gives 15.5 S / 229.3 E at 12:49:53 UT, converted to east-positive (NSSDC prints 130.7 W). One decimal; real uncertainty likely larger.

sites.name: Luna 9 — Oceanus Procellarum
sites.coord_note: Historical value from an early Pravda report; NSSDC footnote says LROC images show no lander at these coordinates, so the true site is probably at least 10 km away. Printed to 0.01 deg but real uncertainty is >0.3 deg.

sites.name: Luna 13 — Oceanus Procellarum
sites.coord_note: Historical reported value (Siddiqi 2002/2018; Ulivi and Harland 2004, per NSSDC footnote), not LROC-confirmed; 297.95 E converted to east-positive. Two decimals; true accuracy likely coarser.

sites.name: Luna 16 — Mare Fecunditatis
sites.coord_note: Lander (descent stage) position measured in LROC images; mean Earth/polar axis. Stated uncertainty 3.7 m.

sites.name: Luna 17 — Mare Imbrium
sites.coord_note: Luna 17 lander (Lunokhod 1 carrier) position measured in LROC images; mean Earth/polar axis; 324.99837 E converted to east-positive. Stated uncertainty 0.5 m.

sites.name: Lunokhod 1 rover (final position)
sites.coord_note: Where the Lunokhod 1 rover stands as imaged by LROC (end of its traverse, not the landing point, which is the Luna 17 entry); mean Earth/polar axis; 324.9919 E converted. Stated uncertainty 3.8 m.

sites.name: Luna 18 crash — Mare Fecunditatis
sites.coord_note: NSSDC marks this as unconfirmed: contact was lost about 100 m above the surface and an object in an LROC image may be the lander. Two decimals.

sites.name: Luna 20 — Apollonius highlands
sites.coord_note: Lander position measured in LROC images; mean Earth/polar axis. Stated uncertainty 4.3 m.

sites.name: Luna 21 — Le Monnier
sites.coord_note: Luna 21 lander (Lunokhod 2 carrier) position from LROC images; mean Earth/polar axis. Stated uncertainty 13.4 m.

sites.name: Lunokhod 2 rover (final position)
sites.coord_note: Where the Lunokhod 2 rover stands as imaged by LROC (end of its traverse; landing point is the Luna 21 entry); mean Earth/polar axis. Stated uncertainty 7.5 m.

sites.name: Luna 23 — Mare Crisium
sites.coord_note: Lander position from LROC images (landed damaged, no sample returned); mean Earth/polar axis. Stated uncertainty 3.0 m.

sites.name: Luna 24 — Mare Crisium
sites.coord_note: Lander position from LROC images; mean Earth/polar axis. Stated uncertainty 3.7 m.

sites.name: Luna 25 crash — near Pontécoulant G
sites.coord_note: Crash crater imaged by LROC (NSSDC footnote d); DE421 mean Earth/polar axis per page. Three decimals (~30 m).

sites.name: SMART-1 impact — Lacus Excellentiae
sites.coord_note: Impact point from Burchell et al. (2015) per NSSDC footnote; 313.8 E converted to east-positive. One decimal (~0.1 deg, ~3 km).

sites.name: Kaguya (SELENE) impact
sites.coord_note: Controlled-impact point from a 2009 JAXA press release per NSSDC footnote; not LROC-confirmed. One decimal.

sites.name: Chang'e 1 impact
sites.coord_note: Controlled-impact point from Xinhua (2009) per NSSDC footnote; Siddiqi (2018) gives 1.66 S, 52.27 E instead. Two decimals; not LROC-confirmed.

sites.name: Chang'e 3 — Mare Imbrium
sites.coord_note: Lander position measured in LROC images; mean Earth/polar axis; 340.4883 E converted to east-positive. Stated uncertainty 9.1 m.

sites.name: Yutu rover (final position)
sites.coord_note: Where the Yutu rover stands as imaged by LROC (a few tens of metres from the lander, after its short traverse); mean Earth/polar axis; 340.4878 E converted. Stated uncertainty 12.9 m.

sites.name: Chang'e 4 — Von Kármán crater (far side)
sites.coord_note: Lander position, imaged by LROC (NSSDC footnote d); DE421 mean Earth/polar axis per page. Four decimals.

sites.name: Yutu-2 rover (deployment point)
sites.coord_note: Two-decimal position at the Chang'e 4 lander (rover deployment); NSSDC notes the rover was still mobile in Jan 2023 about 850 m NW of the lander, final coordinates TBD. DE421 ME frame.

sites.name: Chang'e 5 — Mons Rümker region
sites.coord_note: Lander (descent stage) position, imaged by LROC; DE421 mean Earth/polar axis per page. Four decimals.

sites.name: Chang'e 6 — Apollo basin (far side)
sites.coord_note: Lander position computed by the LROC team from a 7 June 2024 image (stated horizontal accuracy +/-30 m); 206.0148 E converted to east-positive; frame not stated on LROC post, NSSDC gives same value in DE421 ME. NSSDC and LROC agree.

sites.name: Chandrayaan-2 Vikram crash site
sites.coord_note: Vikram impact point, imaged by LROC (NSSDC footnote d); DE421 mean Earth/polar axis per page. Four decimals. Date is UTC (6 Sep), which is 7 Sep in India.

sites.name: Chandrayaan-3 — Shiv Shakti Point
sites.coord_note: Vikram lander position from LROC oblique image; frame not stated on LROC post (NSSDC lists same value in DE421 ME). Latitude to 4 decimals but longitude only 2 (~0.01 deg, ~100 m E-W at this latitude).

sites.name: SLIM — near Shioli crater
sites.coord_note: Lander position, imaged by LROC (NSSDC footnote d); DE421 mean Earth/polar axis per page. Four decimals.

sites.name: ispace Hakuto-R Mission 1 crash — Atlas crater
sites.coord_note: Crash site imaged by LROC (NSSDC footnote d); DE421 mean Earth/polar axis per page. Three decimals (~30 m).

sites.name: ispace Hakuto-R Mission 2 (Resilience) crash — Mare Frigoris
sites.coord_note: Crash site imaged by LROC (NSSDC footnote d); DE421 mean Earth/polar axis per page; given as 4.588 W. Latitude 4 decimals, longitude 3.

sites.name: Beresheet crash — Mare Serenitatis
sites.coord_note: Impact site imaged by LROC (NSSDC footnote d); DE421 mean Earth/polar axis per page. Four decimals.

sites.name: Intuitive Machines IM-1 Odysseus — Malapert A region
sites.coord_note: Lander position (landed tipped over), imaged by LROC (NSSDC footnote d); DE421 mean Earth/polar axis per page. Only two decimals (~0.01 deg, ~300 m N-S).

sites.name: Intuitive Machines IM-2 Athena — Mons Mouton region
sites.coord_note: Lander position (landed on its side), imaged by LROC (NSSDC footnote d); DE421 mean Earth/polar axis per page. Four decimals.

sites.name: Firefly Blue Ghost Mission 1 — Mare Crisium (Mons Latreille)
sites.coord_note: Lander position, imaged by LROC (NSSDC footnote d); DE421 mean Earth/polar axis per page. Three decimals (~30 m).

unlocated.name: Astrobotic Peregrine Mission One
unlocated.reason: Did not reach the lunar surface; no landing or impact site exists. Omitted per scope.

unlocated.name: Surveyor 2 (crash)
unlocated.reason: NSSDC impacts table gives only a coarse historical estimate (5.5 N, 12.0 W) not confirmed by LROC; NSSDC Surveyor page prints no coordinates. Left out as low-confidence.

unlocated.name: Surveyor 4 (crash)
unlocated.reason: NSSDC lists the site as 'Unknown' (parenthetical estimate 0.5 N, 1.5 W); contact lost 2.5 min before touchdown.

unlocated.name: Luna 15 (crash)
unlocated.reason: NSSDC gives 17 N, 60 E but footnote lists conflicting alternates (12 N 59 E; 17 N 49 E); not confirmed.

unlocated.name: Chang'e 5 ascent vehicle (deliberate impact)
unlocated.reason: NSSDC gives only '30. S, 0. E' with a note that it most likely hit at Regiomontanus crater; not a measured position.

unlocated.name: Chandrayaan-1 Moon Impact Probe
unlocated.reason: NSSDC footnote: impacted Shackleton crater area, exact coordinates unknown (table shows rounded 89 S, 30 W).

unlocated.name: Yutu-2 rover current/final position
unlocated.reason: NSSDC states final coordinates are TBD (rover ~850 m NW of Chang'e 4 as of Jan 2023); only the deployment point is listed.

unlocated.name: Apollo LM ascent stages and other Apollo hardware
unlocated.reason: Out of scope for this catalogue (NSSDC gives only seismic estimates or 'Unknown').
